title: Breaking: The Ground Gave It Back
description: After a hard rain, worms surface on every sidewalk in town. Ronnie covers it not as weather but as a geological emergency: the earth is rejecting what it was given. The station's brand-new seismologist says it's textbook, right up until the dirt keeps coughing up things nobody admits to burying.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: We are interrupting the regular hour on Snazzie FM for breaking ground conditions. Stay off the lawns. <p:0.3> Overnight, the earth gave it back.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: It rained, Ronnie. That's it. It rained.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Gave back its worms, Barry. Thousands of them. On every sidewalk in town. <p:0.3> I'm putting us under a Soil Advisory, Tier One.

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Yeah, hi, Ronnie. So. <p:0.3> I'm out front counting. <p:0.3> I'm at four hundred worms and the parking lot has more than the sidewalk.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Because worms surface after rain. They drown down there. They come up. It is the most ordinary thing a worm does.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: We've got a professional standing by. Brand new to the station. Doctor Vance, our seismologist. You're on the air.

lines.speaker: caller-dr-vance
lines.text: Thanks, Ronnie. And I want to reassure your listeners. <p:0.3> Worms surfacing after heavy rain is textbook. Completely textbook. There is no seismic component.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Thank you. <p:0.3> A scientist. Finally.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: Hello, dear, it's Patricia on Maple. <p:0.3> The worms are lovely, but my flowerbed pushed up something this morning. <p:0.3> It pushed up my late husband's golf clubs.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Folks. <p:0.3> The ground gave it back.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Or, Patricia, you buried golf clubs in your flowerbed and forgot. People do that.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: I did not bury them, dear. <p:0.3> Walter was buried with those clubs. In June. <p:0.3> Across town.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Doctor Vance. Is that textbook.

lines.speaker: caller-dr-vance
lines.text: That is... that's a coincidence. Soil shifts. Things migrate. <p:0.3> Although, I will say, my instrument just twitched, and that... should not be on the seismograph.

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: [dissatisfaction-hnn] Yeah, this is Sal. <p:0.3> I just want it on record that I don't know nothin' about no box.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Nobody asked you about a box, Sal.

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: Right. And there isn't one. So we're good.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: I'm upgrading us to a Soil Advisory, Tier Three. <p:0.3> The earth is rejecting what it was given, and it is not finished.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: Ronnie, dear, it's pushed up more. <p:0.3> A ring that is not my ring. And a second phone. <p:0.3> Walter only had the one phone that I knew about.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: A ring. <p:0.3> The ground gave it back.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Patricia, that is between you and Walter, not you and the topsoil.

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Ronnie? <p:0.3> Update. I stopped counting worms. <p:0.3> The flowerbed by the door surfaced a casserole dish. <p:0.3> It says property of Saint Bevin's on the bottom.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: That dish, Todd, has been missing for three years. Earl filed paperwork on it.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: A casserole dish. <p:0.3> The ground gave it back. Doctor Vance, give me a reading.

lines.speaker: caller-dr-vance
lines.text: I can't, Ronnie. The needle is just... drawing. <p:0.3> It is drawing a box. The seismograph is drawing a small rectangular box and that... that should not be on the seismograph.

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: What box. WHAT box. I don't know nothin' about no box!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Sal, you keep defending a box no one mentioned.

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: His yard's on the map, Ronnie. <p:0.3> Sal's back lawn just heaved. There's a corner of something metal coming up.

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: That's a SPRINKLER part! That's nothin'! Push it back DOWN!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You can't push it back down, Sal. <p:0.3> The ground gave it back.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: Sal, dear, mine came up too. <p:0.3> You just have to let it.

lines.speaker: caller-dr-vance
lines.text: Everyone, this is textbook, it is absolutely text... <p:0.3> no. <p:0.3> The whole town is on the instrument now. Every lawn. All at once.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: It RAINED, doctor!

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: It's a SPRINKLER!

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: Two phones, dear!

lines.speaker: caller-dr-vance
lines.text: Not textbook!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Soil Advisory, Tier Five!

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Ronnie. <p:0.4> The station lot just surfaced something. <p:0.3> It's a lockbox. <p:0.3> It says Snazzie FM on the lid.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: ...Whose is it, Todd.

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Nobody's claiming it. <p:0.4> But there's a name scratched under the handle. <p:0.3> It's, um. <p:0.3> It's yours, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie. <p:0.3> The ground gave it back.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: ...We're downgrading the advisory. <p:0.4> This one's a private matter. We'll be right back after a word.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: It rained, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: It always rains eventually, Barry.
